messages:
maya: Hey product/design — quick review? Putting scope selector (Account / Project) as a chip in the header vs as a toolbar switcher. Also where to place invoice download + token breakdown toggle in compact spend mode. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/CompactSpend_v3. Thoughts before dev handoff?
sam: Prefer chip. Less visual noise and aligns w/ other consoles. But needs clear affordance when you have multiple orgs. :thinking:
ali: Chip OK, but we lose discoverability for infrequent users. Can we add a subtle chevron + tooltip on hover? Also need keyboard focus styles.
kelly: Agree re: focus styles. For accessibility make sure aria-expanded on the chip. Example: `button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="scope-menu"`
noah: About invoice download: currently in top-right actions. In compact mode that area gets crowded. Proposal: move download into a persistent 'Export' action in the left rail, with a smaller 'quick download' icon in header for power users.
maya: I worry left rail is too far for users who think in terms of current view. What about keeping a tiny icon next to scope chip that opens a menu: Download / CSV / PDF / Billing contact?
ali: Love that. But ensure the menu doesn't obscure the chart legend. Use `menuPlacement: 'bottom-end'` and test on small widths.
kelly: :white_check_mark: Also add screen-reader only text: 'Download invoice for selected scope and date range'
figma-bot: New frame uploaded: CompactSpend_v3 — scope-chip-with-actions — https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/CompactSpend_v3
sam: :thumbsup: One more micro-ux: token breakdown rows — the token counts are dense. Suggest making numeric values monospaced and right-aligned, and add a visual divider between token type and cost.
noah: Right-align + monospace helps scan. Also add tooltip on hover showing token calculation: base + prompt + completion.
maya: Great. Can someone add a small accessibility test to the PR checklist: keyboard nav to chip, menu focus trap, aria-labels on download, contrast on token labels?
kelly: I'll add to checklist. Will also run axe on the new frame.
ali: Can we offer a setting to default to 'Project' scope for users with many projects? Might reduce confusion on first visit.
sam: That would require persisting in user prefs. OK as follow up.
maya: Perfect — moving to dev handoff after these tweaks. I'll update Figma with aria notes and add the checklist items. Thanks everyone :rocket:
